evidence_chain.link: Marfan syndrome is characterized by cardiovascular and musculoskeletal abnormalities, including bilateral inferior lens dislocation
evidence_chain.quote: Findings include valvular prolapse and aortic aneurysm. A diastolic murmur may be heard over the aortic valve.

evidence_chain.link: Ehlers-Danlos syndrome is a collagen disease that can cause joint hypermobility and skin hyperextensibility, and may be associated with bilateral inferior lens dislocation
evidence_chain.quote: There can also be soft tissue problems related or not to collagen diseases such as generalized hyperlaxity or Ehlers–Danlos syndrome that may be related to postoperative recurrence after Latarjet.

ranked_facts.why: bilateral inferior lens dislocation is a key feature of both Marfan syndrome and Ehlers-Danlos syndrome

evidence_chain.link: Marfan syndrome is characterized by tall stature and arachnodactyly, which are key diagnostic features
evidence_chain.quote: Patients are taller than average for age and family; arm span exceeds height. Arachnodactyly (disproportionately long, thin digits) is noticeable, often by the thumb sign (the distal phalanx of the thumb protrudes beyond the edge of the clenched fist).

ranked_facts.why: tall stature with arachnodactyly is a key feature of Marfan syndrome
